issue_title: Let a report schedule be deferred, with a note saying why
issue_body:
Teams pause report schedules by deleting them, and nobody remembers why a report stopped arriving. Add two optional fields to the schedule definition: `delivery` (`now` or `deferred`; absent means `now`) and `deferral_note` (free text).

A deferred schedule must say why: a schedule with `delivery: deferred` needs a `deferral_note` that is neither empty nor only whitespace. A `deferral_note` on a schedule that is not deferred is meaningless and must be refused, so a stale note never outlives its deferral. The dispatcher must not run deferred schedules.

plan.summary: Add the delivery and deferral_note schedule fields, require the note for deferred schedules in the JSON Schema and schedule.Validate, and skip deferred schedules in the dispatcher.

approach.description: Add optional delivery (enum now, deferred) and deferral_note (string) properties to schemas/schedule.schema.json, with a root if/then: when delivery is deferred, deferral_note is required. Add the matching fields to schedule.Schedule in internal/schedule/schedule.go.

In schedule.Validate (internal/schedule/validate.go), beside the existing cron-expression check, reject a deferral_note that is empty or whitespace-only, and a deferral_note on a schedule whose delivery is not deferred, each with an error naming deferral_note.
In internal/dispatch/dispatcher.go, skip a schedule whose delivery is deferred and log its deferral_note.
Document delivery and deferral_note in api/openapi.yaml's Schedule schema.

verification.test_strategy: Schema fixture tests: a deferred schedule without deferral_note fails the schema. Table tests for schedule.Validate covering an empty note, a whitespace-only note, a note on a delivery-now schedule and a valid deferred schedule. A dispatcher test with one deferred and one active schedule.
verification.rollback_plan: Revert the PR. Stored schedules keep their delivery and deferral_note keys, which the previous binary ignores, so deferred schedules run again.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The dispatcher runs no report for a schedule whose delivery is deferred.
schemas/schedule.schema.json rejects a schedule whose delivery is deferred and which has no deferral_note.
schedule.Validate returns an error naming deferral_note for a deferred schedule whose deferral_note is empty or whitespace-only, and for a delivery-now schedule that carries a deferral_note.

POST /schedules returns HTTP 400 naming deferral_note for each of four bodies: delivery deferred with deferral_note absent, delivery deferred with deferral_note empty, delivery deferred with deferral_note whitespace-only, and deferral_note set while delivery is now.
acceptance_criteria.rationale: The issue requires these schedules to be refused; schedules enter the service through POST /schedules, so each refusal is observable there.
acceptance_criteria.verify_hint: POST each of the four bodies to /schedules and read the status and the error.

risks_and_assumptions: Existing schedules have no delivery key and read as now, so they keep running.

POST /schedules (internal/api/schedules.go) checks each body against schemas/schedule.schema.json, returns 400 naming the failing property on a violation and otherwise stores the schedule with 201; schedule.Validate runs when the dispatcher loads a schedule.

catch_probes: schedules.go is not in the scope
three of the four are stored
three of the four are accepted

catching_examples.note: ac-post-deferral-note-400 is only partly satisfiable: the schema's if/then enforces only presence, and POST /schedules never runs schedule.Validate, so the empty, whitespace and unpaired bodies return 201.

ac-post-deferral-note-400 cannot pass as planned: the POST handler only validates against the schema, and schedule.Validate runs only when the dispatcher loads a schedule, so three of the four are stored.
The criterion where POST /schedules returns HTTP 400 for each of four bodies would fail as planned: schedules.go is not in scope and nothing wires the blank-note check into the handler.
ac-post-deferral-note-400: only the absent-note body is refused at POST; the blank, whitespace and delivery-now cases return 201 because the handler does not call schedule.Validate.
ac-post-deferral-note-400 expects 400 for all four bodies, but the schema can't reject a blank note and the semantic check is not wired into the POST path.

non_catching_examples.note: ac-post-deferral-note-400 should also assert the error body points at deferral_note with a JSON pointer.
ac-post-deferral-note-400 is ambiguous: four bodies in one criterion is unjustified; split it so a failure names the body.
Document a length limit for deferral_note in api/openapi.yaml.
ac-dispatcher-skips-deferred: add a test that a deferred schedule's next run time is still computed.
Approach step 3 logs the deferral_note; redact it if it can carry customer names.
ac-validate-note-rules: include a tab-only note among the whitespace cases.
ac-post-deferral-note-400: the 400 error code should be a stable string, not free text.
